## Session Abstract & Key Takeaways

**Production GitOps at Scale with ArgoCD and Crossplane.**

This session explores declarative infrastructure control planes.
Attendees will learn:
- Continuous delivery workflows
- Automated rollback on health check failure
- Multi-cluster application synchronization
